## `virtualization.vm.cpu.count`

| Name | Instrument Type | Unit (UCUM) | Description | Stability | Entity Associations |
| -------- | --------------- | ----------- | -------------- | --------- | ------ |
| `virtualization.vm.cpu.count` | UpDownCounter | `{vcpu}` | The number of virtual CPUs (vCPUs) currently allocated to the virtual machine. [1] | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `virtualization.vm` |

**Requirement Level:** `Recommended`

**[1]:** Reports the current vCPU allocation, which may differ from the maximum configured count on hypervisors that support hot-add of vCPUs. In IBM Z PR/SM (classic mode) this corresponds to the total processor count fields on the logical partition object via the HMC Web Services API. In VMware ESXi it corresponds to config.numCpu. In Microsoft Hyper-V it corresponds to the virtual processor count property of the VM configuration.

**Attributes:**

| Key | Stability | [Requirement Level](https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/general/attribute-requirement-level/) | Value Type | Description | Example Values |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`virtualization.vm.id`](/docs/registry/virtualization/README.md#virtualization-vm-id) | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `Required` | string | Unique identifier for the virtual machine instance. [1] | `SSIPLEX1/LINUX01`; `502e7c9a-1b2d-4f3e-8a6b-7c8d9e0f1a2b` |

**[1] `virtualization.vm.id`:** Uniquely identifies the virtual machine across its live-migration domain, so the identity survives vMotion, KVM live migration and z/VM Live Guest Relocation. It never includes the host or hypervisor the VM runs on.
- IBM z/VM: the SSI cluster name (or the z/VM system name outside an SSI
  cluster) and the guest user ID, e.g. `SSIPLEX1/LINUX01`.
- VMware vSphere: the VM `instanceUuid`. - KVM / libvirt: the domain UUID.
